start: Settings, owner signed in, gym online

user_sees: Title 'Settings', 'Gym details, opening times and the admin app', tabs 'Gym', 'Member app', 'Sign-in & data'; card 'Gym details' with 'Gym name', 'Phone', 'GSTIN (optional)', 'Address', 'Gym UPI ID (optional)'
must_not: Another gym's details in the boxes after switching gym or branch
The data actions shown on the Gym tab

steps.action: Change the gym name and type the gym's UPI ID, tap save
user_sees: Toast 'Saved.'; the new name in the panel and in members' app; the UPI ID used in fee and renewal messages and at the desk QR
must_not: 'Saved.' when the save failed
A UPI ID with a typing mistake saved without a word
The old gym's UPI ID given to a newly opened gym

user_sees: 'What your members see in the MettleUp app': the join code card, 'Your look in the app' with 'Open branding', 'Challenges'
must_not: Buttons that work for a browser-only gym when they need the server

user_sees: 'Your sign-in, staff, backups and your gym’s records': sign-in, 'Download a backup', 'Your gym’s records' with 'Saved online. Safe if a phone or computer breaks. The same on every phone or computer you sign in on.', 'Import members from Excel'
must_not: 'Saved online' shown for a browser-only gym

start: Settings, Sign-in & data tab (entry: download all the gym's data)

user_sees: Card 'Download a backup': 'Download every member, plan, payment and check-in as an Excel file. Keep it on your phone or computer. We suggest once a month.'
'Downloaded: an Excel file and a full copy.' and the day of the last download
must_not: A file missing members, plans, payments or check-ins
Rows of another gym
'Downloaded' when no file was made
A formula in a member's name run by Excel

user_sees: Every member, plan, payment and check-in of this gym, readable, with dates as the gym means them
must_not: Phone numbers turned into 9.87E+09
Dates a day early

start: Settings, Sign-in & data tab, Danger zone (entry: the leaving actions)

user_sees: A sheet that says what is deleted and when, with 'Cancel' and a red send button
must_not: The gym deleted at once by this tap
The button shown for a browser-only gym

user_sees: A green line that the request was sent; MettleUp calls the gym's number before anything is deleted
must_not: Nothing shown when the send failed
Records deleted before the call
The request sent with members' names or numbers in it

steps.action: Clear the gym name, tap save
user_sees: An error under 'Gym name'; nothing saved
must_not: A gym with no name
'Saved.'

steps.action: Type a GSTIN with a wrong shape, tap save
user_sees: An error under 'GSTIN (optional)'
must_not: A wrong GSTIN printed on receipts

steps.action: Type a UPI ID with no @ (or with spaces), tap save
user_sees: An error under 'Gym UPI ID (optional)'
must_not: A pay link that sends members' money to a wrong or broken UPI ID

steps.action: Turn the internet off, tap save
user_sees: The save button says it needs the internet
must_not: A save that looks done but never reaches the server

start: Settings on a browser-only gym (not online)

user_sees: A question first; then the demo gym's made-up members; the Gym details boxes show the demo gym
must_not: The owner's real gym wiped with no question
The old gym's UPI ID left in the box

steps.action: Tap 'Erase and start fresh' and confirm
user_sees: A question first; then an empty gym
must_not: An online gym's records touched
No way to cancel

steps.action: Put the gym online, open Sign-in & data again
user_sees: 'Load demo gym' and 'Erase and start fresh' are gone; 'Download a backup' and the delete request are there
must_not: Erase offered for an online gym

steps.action: Read 'Your gym’s records' and the Danger zone
user_sees: Where the records are kept; that MettleUp support can look only if the owner lets them; that a delete request removes every member, payment, check-in and shop order from the server within 30 days
must_not: Support access switched on by itself
The backup file sent anywhere but this device
Staff able to download every member's phone number
